ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS:
The memo omits the "commercially reasonable efforts" exception to the minimum hedging covenant (found in Section 6.17(b) of the source document). This provision states that the Borrower can be deemed compliant with the 70% hedging requirement if they have made commercially reasonable efforts to obtain such hedges but have not received offers at market rates. This is a material qualification of the covenant.
